hierarchy: reports → report key → periods → period key → variants → groups → rows
canonicalMapping: Not supplied by presentation schema. Canonical semantics established only by retained reviewed source captions/definitions and contracts; equality/code coincidence never sufficient.
identityAndAudit: Hash-bound document metadata and retained qualification are needed; filename hints and OCR scope candidates alone are insufficient.
unitPolicy: PDF page-declared candidate units; CafeF undeclared units remain unknown, no conversion guessed.
periodPolicy: Annual, quarter and YTD variants retained. Known Q2/YTD OCR ambiguity prevents period-key-only promotion.
unknownsAreNotInvalidFacts: Missing optional metadata is not itself a Level1 rejection.
